name: Exp_XMACD
summary: This EA trades based on the XMACD custom indicator, offering four distinct signal modes: zero-line breakthrough, MACD direction change, signal line direction change, and MACD-signal line crossover. It opens and closes positions according to the selected mode with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义XMACD指标进行交易，提供四种信号模式：零线突破、MACD方向改变、信号线方向改变以及MACD与信号线交叉。根据所选模式开平仓，并支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于XMACD指标的动量策略进行交易，XMACD是传统MACD的扩展版本，支持多种平滑算法（SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等）和多种价格类型。策略提供四种入场模式：零线突破模式在MACD柱状图穿越零线时交易；MACD扭转模式在MACD改变方向时交易；信号线扭转模式在信号线改变方向时交易；MACD交叉模式在MACD柱状图穿越信号线时交易，这是最经典的MACD交易方式。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓、固定止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例下单。策略使用了IsNewBar机制来避免同根K线内重复交易，并通过Recount机制在数据复制失败时重新计算信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a momentum-based strategy using the XMACD indicator, which is an extended version of the traditional MACD supporting multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, JJMA, JurX, etc.) and various price types. The strategy offers four entry modes: the zero-line breakthrough mode trades when the MACD histogram crosses zero; the MACD twist mode trades when the MACD changes direction; the signal line twist mode trades when the signal line changes direction; and the MACD crossover mode trades when the MACD histogram crosses the signal line, which is the most classic MACD trading approach. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals, fixed stop loss, and take profit levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent a percentage of the deposit. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar and employs a Recount flag to recalculate signals when data copying fails.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易份额比例，负值为固定手数
parameters.description_en: Trade volume ratio; negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit percentage

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏离点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max price deviation (slippage tolerance) in points

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：零线突破/MACD扭转/信号线扭转/MACD交叉
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm: zero-line breakout / MACD reversal / signal line reversal / MACD crossover

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 提供四种交易模式，策略灵活度高，适应不同市场环境
使用IsNewBar新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复交易
支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，XMACD指标功能比标准MACD更强大
有完整的买入/卖出开仓和平仓权限控制，精细化管理交易方向
固定止损止盈设置合理，风险可控
pros_en: Offers four trading modes providing high strategic flexibility to adapt to different market conditions
Uses IsNewBar mechanism to prevent repeated trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms and price types, making XMACD more powerful than standard MACD
Provides granular permission controls for buy/sell opening and closing positions independently
Fixed stop loss and take profit settings provide defined risk management
cons: 没有追踪止损机制，盈利可能因市场回撤而减少
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号
MM参数为负值时表示固定手数的设计不够直观，容易混淆
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能存在重复开仓风险
依赖外部iCustom指标，若XMACD指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
cons_en: No trailing stop mechanism, profits may be reduced by market retracements
No spread filter, potentially generating false signals in high-spread environments
The MM parameter design where negative values mean fixed lots is unintuitive and error-prone
Lacks position checking logic before opening trades, risking duplicate positions
Depends on external iCustom indicator, the EA will fail if the XMACD indicator file is missing
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加点差过滤和最大持仓检查，提高交易的鲁棒性
改进MM参数设计，使用枚举类型区分固定手数和比例手数模式，避免负值混淆
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop feature to lock in more profits during trend continuation
Add spread filter and maximum position check to improve trading robustness
Redesign the MM parameter using an enum to distinguish between fixed lot and percentage modes, eliminating the confusing negative value convention

risk_points: 没有持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
固定止损止盈虽存在但数值较大（1000/2000点），可能承受较大单笔亏损
依赖外部自定义指标，指标缺失时仅打印警告但未阻止EA继续运行
risk_points_en: No position count check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Fixed stop loss/take profit values are large (1000/2000 points), allowing significant per-trade losses
Depends on external custom indicator; when missing, only a warning is printed but the EA continues running

It opens and closes positions according to the selected mode with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
